bio.text: Kristin Nelson, a Republican, has represented District 38 in the Alabama House of Representatives since February 3, 2026, when she won a special general election, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for a full term.
According to Ballotpedia, her career experience includes working as a teacher.
She has been affiliated with Fairfax Methodist Church, the Chambers County Young Republicans and the Chambers County Republican Party.
